title: SaveLedsRequest
description: POST /save/leds body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; shown here as the values before encoding). Omitted fields keep their value, out-of-range values are clamped. Saved; `brightness`, `power_limit_w` and `pixel_watts` apply immediately (the strip is redrawn in both modes), `num_leds` and `color` show right away only in plain mode, color correction and `smoothing_ms` apply to the TV picture from then on. Replies with Esp32Message.
